name: Cyborg Oni
body:
Cyborg Oni
CR 4

XP 1,200
Fast zombie (cyborg) ogre mage
N Large construct
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 11, flat-footed 20 (+8 armor, +2 Dex, +3 natural, -1 size)
hp 85 (10d10+30)
Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +7
Immune construct traits

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee greatsword +14/+9 (3d6+12/19-20) and slam +14 (1d8+8)
Ranged composite longbow +10/+5 (2d6+8)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 19, Con -, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +7; CMB +16; CMD 30
SQ construct traits
Gear Large greatsword, Large composite longbow, 10 arrows, o-yoroi armor

ABOUT

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or gang (3-6)
Treasure none

These techno-organic creatures are a blend of flesh and bone with metal and machinery, with wires and myometric servos grafted into organic tissue stretched tight across its metallic endo- and exoskeletal apparatus.
